_comment: Phase I — Claude Code Dogfood Worker Registry Example.
Copy this file to {dataRoot}/_relay/workers/claude-dogfood.json
and replace <REPLACE_WITH_ABSOLUTE_WRAPPER_PATH> with the
absolute path to scripts/relay-worker-claude.mjs in your checkout.
Windows example:
C:\Users\you\repos\agent-relay-log-dev01\scripts\relay-worker-claude.mjs
launchCommand must be 'node' (allowlisted basename).
launchArgsPrefix[0] must be the absolute path to relay-worker-claude.mjs.
observationAdapterId must be 'claude-code' — the registered Phase H adapter.
capabilities: ['coding'] marks this worker as a general coding executor.
driverOptions.claude.permissionMode:
'acceptEdits' — Claude auto-accepts file edits in --print (non-interactive) mode.
Required for Claude to create/modify files without a human-in-the-loop.
'default' or absent — Claude uses its own default (least privilege).
'dangerously-skip-permissions' is NOT supported by this driver.
driverOptions.claude.allowedTools (round 35, ar/v1-pm, optional):
Strict Builder verification allowlist. In --print mode every Bash tool call
is auto-rejected unless allow-listed, so the Builder declares the bounded
verify-only commands it may run. Only Bash(<cmd>:*) with <cmd> in
{node, npm, npx, git status, git diff, git log, ls, cat, head, tail, wc,
grep, rg, find, test}, or exactly one of Read/Glob/Grep/Edit/Write.
The registry AND the wrapper reject everything else (rm, sudo, pkill,
git push, wildcard-only patterns) as fatal. QA workers must never set it
— the QA passthrough rejects --allowedTool outright.
driverOptions is trusted Worker Registry configuration only.
Task/Goal/PM narrative CANNOT override or supply permissionMode or allowedTools.
Do NOT include secrets, tokens, or personal paths in this file.
Do NOT commit the live registry file to the repository.
Remove _comment before deploying (JSON spec forbids comments).
Or keep it — the registry validator rejects unknown fields.
This example file is docs-only and is never loaded by the registry.
